title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions Companion Coverage Sheet
content:
Each Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product states how many companions on the same reservation are covered without an add-on, whether one companion's coverage may be added for a fee and at what price for the rest of the term, whether a covered companion must be on the holder's reservation and flights, and whether household members other than covered companions may use the benefits.

| Subscription | Companions covered without an add-on | Companion add-on available | Price of adding one companion for the rest of the term (USD) | Covered companion must be on the holder's reservation and flights | Household members other than covered companions may use the benefits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 0 | Yes | 149 | Yes | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 1 | No | 0 (not offered) | Yes | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 0 | Yes | 199 | Yes | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 1 | No | 0 (not offered) | Yes | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 0 | Yes | 299 | Yes | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 1 | No | 0 (not offered) | Yes | No |

## Reading the sheet

- **Included companion.** Bag Pass Two, Seat Pass Network and Seat and Bag Pass Network each cover 1 companion without an add-on; none of the three offers the add-on.
- **Paid add-on.** Bag Pass One, Seat Pass Domestic and Seat and Bag Pass Domestic include no companion; each offers the add-on, at 149, 199 and 299 USD respectively.
- **Same reservation.** For every subscription a covered companion must be on the holder's reservation and flights.
- **Household.** For every subscription, no household member other than a covered companion may use the benefits.
